projects.name: Air-Gesture-Mouse-Control
projects.description: Air Gesture Mouse Control is a real-time Computer Vision application that lets you control your computer's mouse cursor using only your hand — no touching required. Move your index finger in the air to move the cursor, and pinch your thumb and index finger together to click. It works entirely offline using your webcam.
projects.summary: Real-time Computer Vision app that controls the mouse cursor with hand gestures via webcam—move with the index finger and pinch to click. Fully offline with MediaPipe/OpenCV.

projects.name: bank_account_management-Week2Tech4Edges
projects.summary: Dart OOP console app for bank accounts—deposit, withdraw, balance—with Savings/Current inheritance (Tech4Edges Week 2).

projects.name: Face-Skeleton-Cyber-Mesh-Tracker
projects.description: Face Skeleton & Cyber Mesh Tracker is a real-time desktop Computer Vision app built with MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Tkinter. It maps 468/478 3D facial landmarks onto the live camera feed, renders a futuristic cyber-mesh wireframe over the face, and computes real-time head pose (Pitch, Yaw, Roll) along with blink, smile, and mouth-aspect telemetry.
projects.summary: Real-time desktop CV app that maps 468/478 3D facial landmarks, renders a cyber-mesh wireframe, and computes head pose (Pitch/Yaw/Roll) plus blink, smile, and mouth-aspect telemetry.

projects.name: Flappy_Bird_PyGame
projects.description: A modern reimagining of the classic Flappy Bird arcade game — built from scratch in Python using PyGame. Navigate a bird through procedurally generated pipes, collect shiny coins for bonus points, and compete against your own high score. Smooth physics, sprite animations, background music & sound effects bring the retro experience to life.
projects.summary: Modern Flappy Bird remake in PyGame with procedurally generated pipes, coin collection, high scores, sprite animations, and sound effects.

projects.name: GTA-V-Worldwide-Sales-Player-Analytics
projects.summary: Interactive analytics dashboard for GTA V worldwide sales and player trends across countries with maps, filters, and KPI cards.

projects.name: Hand-Skeleton-Tracker-i
projects.description: Hand Skeleton Tracker is a real-time desktop Computer Vision app built with MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Tkinter. It precisely tracks 21 3D hand landmarks per hand — Wrist, Thumb, Index, Middle, Ring, and Pinky joints — and renders a glowing futuristic skeleton overlay, complete with live pinch-gesture (thumb-to-index) distance measurement.
projects.summary: Real-time desktop CV app tracking 21 3D hand landmarks per hand with a glowing skeleton overlay and live pinch-gesture distance measurement.

projects.name: HireLens
projects.description: HireLens — Streamlit-powered ATS resume scoring app. Instant CV checks for applicants, bulk screening + automated rejection emails for HR.
projects.summary: Streamlit-powered ATS resume scoring app for instant CV checks against job requirements.

projects.name: Practice_Advanced_python_with_jupyterNotebook
projects.description: This repository contains my hands-on Python practice using Jupyter Notebook. It includes well-structured notebooks with practical examples, exercises, and clear documentation as I learn Python from basics to advanced concepts. The goal of this repo is to build strong Python fundamentals, practice regularly, and share my learning journey publicly.
projects.summary: Hands-on advanced Python practice notebooks covering deeper language features beyond the basics.

projects.name: Practice_python_with_jupyterNotebook
projects.description: Jupyter NoteBooks to get you boosted with the basics of python with hands-on-practice
projects.summary: Jupyter notebooks teaching Python basics with hands-on practice from fundamentals toward OOP and file handling.

projects.name: qr-nova
projects.description: QR Nova is a sleek, dark-themed QR Code Generator built entirely in Python using Tkinter. Type in any text or URL and instantly generate a fully customizable QR code — pick your own colors, error correction level, and even embed a logo right in the center.
projects.summary: Dark-themed QR Code Generator in Python/Tkinter with custom colors, embedded logos, PNG export, clipboard copy, and generation history.

projects.name: Attendance-Through-Face-Recognition
projects.description: FaceRoll is a real-time face recognition system built with OpenCV and the face_recognition library (dlib-based). It learns a set of known faces from a folder of student photos, then opens a live webcam feed and identifies each face it sees on screen — drawing a green box + name for recognized students
projects.summary: FaceRoll — real-time student face recognition attendance with OpenCV and face_recognition; encodes faces from photos and flags unknowns live.

projects.name: chat_bot
projects.description: Chat Bot is a general-purpose AI assistant built with Streamlit for the UI and Groq's gpt-oss-120b model for responses. Ask it anything — general knowledge, writing help, code, explanations — and get fast, streamed answers in a clean chat interface.
projects.summary: Multi-model AI Chat Helper built with Streamlit and Groq, supporting docs and vision capabilities in a dark-themed UI.

projects.name: Driver-Sleep-Drowsiness-Detection-System
projects.description: Driver Sleep & Drowsiness Detection System (DMS) is a real-time Computer Vision app built with MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Tkinter. It performs multi-factor fatigue analysis (eye closure, yawning, and head slumps) and computes a scientific PERCLOS score. The system triggers flashing alerts and audio alarms on live webcam or recorded footage.
projects.summary: Driver Monitoring System (DMS) using PERCLOS, yawn, and head-nod detection with audio-visual alarms and incident CSV logging.

projects.name: Expense_Tracker_App-Week4Tech4Edges-
projects.description: Personal Expense Tracker is a Flutter application that helps users manage their daily expenses — add, edit, and delete transactions, see running totals, and keep everything saved locally on the device using Shared Preferences, with app-wide state managed through Provider.
projects.summary: Flutter personal expense tracker with add/edit/delete, totals, Provider state management, and SharedPreferences local persistence.

projects.name: Satellite-Drought-Early-Warning-Detection
projects.description: A Streamlit dashboard for the Satellite-Based Agricultural Drought Early Warning System. Visualizes NDVI/VCI/rainfall/temperature trends and predicts drought severity (Normal / Mild / Moderate / Severe) using a Random Forest model.
projects.summary: DroughtWatch — Streamlit dashboard for satellite-based agricultural drought early warning using NDVI, rainfall, and temperature signals with ML severity prediction.

projects.name: Student_Directory_App-Week3Tech4Edges
projects.description: A Flutter app that lists students, lets you search by name, add a new student through a validated form, and view full details for any student.
projects.summary: Flutter student directory with search, validated add forms, profile views, and reusable widgets (listed language may show C++ from native bits).

projects.name: tic_tac_toe
projects.description: Tic Tac Toe is a polished, browser-based version of the classic game built entirely with Streamlit. Play locally with a friend, or challenge a computer opponent powered by the minimax algorithm — with three difficulty levels ranging from a coin-flip to a mathematically unbeatable AI
projects.summary: Browser/Streamlit Tic Tac Toe with PvP and unbeatable AI modes, animated UI, and persistent scoreboard.

projects.name: Footstep-Calculator-Gait-Tracker
projects.description: Footstep Calculator & Gait Tracker is a real-time Computer Vision app built with MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Tkinter. It analyzes walking gait from video or webcam by detecting footsteps, stance/swing phases, and ground strikes via ankle/heel velocity analysis. Features include an animated ripple wave, oscilloscope waveform, and live cadence metrics.
projects.summary: Real-time gait analytics app detecting footsteps, cadence (SPM), stride metrics, and knee flexion angles with CSV export.

projects.name: shoe_pred
projects.description: A clean, modern Streamlit dashboard that predicts a person's shoe size from their height, weight, and gender using a trained Linear Regression model.
projects.summary: Streamlit dashboard that predicts shoe size from height, weight, and gender using a trained Linear Regression model, with dark glassmorphism UI and model metrics.

projects.name: Unified-Holistic-Skeleton-Tracker
projects.description: Unified Holistic Skeleton Tracker is the flagship real-time Computer Vision app of this suite, built with MediaPipe, OpenCV, and Tkinter. It simultaneously tracks Body (33 landmarks), Hands (42 landmarks), and Face (468 landmarks) in a single live pipeline.
projects.summary: Flagship real-time holistic tracker combining body (33), hands (42), and face (468) landmarks with joint angles and posture analytics in one MediaPipe/OpenCV desktop app.
notable_features: Body + hands + face in one view

projects.name: Doc_Chatbot
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that answers questions about a document you upload (PDF, DOCX, or TXT). No LLM training happens here — a pretrained embedding model finds the relevant parts of your document, and a pretrained LLM (Claude, via the Anthropic API) answers using only that retrieved context, citing the source file and page.
projects.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that answers questions about uploaded documents.
